name: log_triage
description: Triage one or more log files: classify failures, extract stack traces, and propose next-step debug actions.

parameters.name: log_files
parameters.description: Presigned URLs or S3 keys for the logs to inspect.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional human context (last successful run, recent change, etc.).

args.system: You are an SRE assistant. Classify each log into {OOM, GPU error, IO failure, Slurm step error, dependency error, unknown}. Return JSON keyed by file.
Extract the deepest meaningful Python/C++/CUDA stack trace from each log. Return one trace per file as JSON.
For each file, propose at most 3 concrete next-step actions. Cross-reference the classification and the extracted trace. Output as a markdown checklist.
